neighbours.label: describing how a needle or injection procedure is performed (aspiration, injection, needle insertion), the other side of the + pole's open-incision surgery
fire: Fluid is withdrawn from the joint through a fine needle under local anesthetic.
The nurse gives the vaccine as an injection into the upper arm.
A sample of bone marrow is taken by inserting a needle into the hip bone.
Epidural steroid injections can ease pain from a pinched nerve.
In amniocentesis, a thin needle is passed through the belly into the womb.
The dentist numbs the gum with a quick injection before the filling.
Botox is injected into the forehead muscles in several small doses.
The cyst was drained by aspiration with a syringe in the clinic.
quiet: Fluid is removed from the joint after the surgeon opens the knee.
The surgeon opens the chest with a long cut along the breastbone.
A sample of bone is taken after a large incision over the hip.
Spinal fusion surgery can ease pain from a damaged disc.
In a caesarean section, the doctor cuts through the belly into the womb.
The dentist pulls the tooth and stitches the gum after the extraction.
The facelift involves an incision in front of the ear and along the hairline.
The cyst was cut out through an open incision in the operating room.

notes: card: - pole tops are bone-marrow aspiration, joint injections, lumbar puncture; + pole tops are open incisions and invasiveness. Probes: needle sentences 0.33-0.35, an open incision -0.001. Near misses are open-surgery descriptions of the same body sites.
